summary: Ambient Homebrew Rust can shadow the repository rustup toolchain.
root_cause: On 2026-09-13, /opt/homebrew/bin/rustc and cargo preceded ~/.cargo/bin rustup proxies in PATH. Stakes-class: break-shaped; a green local Cargo run can use a different compiler than CI and leave the sole authorized remote commit unrepairable. Falsifier: with Homebrew before Cargo home in ambient PATH, `just doctor` must still report rustup-managed Rust 1.98.1; reporting Homebrew rustc or cargo paths disproves the fix.
fix: Keep rust-toolchain.toml as the sole compiler selector; derive Cargo home in Justfile, prepend its bin directory, and run just doctor before accepting toolchain evidence.
